body.name: Unequal-three-arm allocation face and boundary stratification
body.construction: For \(r\in\mathcal R_{n,3}\), set \(u_r=n^{1/6}(r/n-q^\dagger)\) and \(\mathcal F_n(M)=\{r:\|u_r\|_\infty\le M\}\). For \(0\le j\le J_n(M)\), define \[\mathcal S_{n,j}(M)=\{r:\min_ar_a>0,\ 2^jM<\|u_r\|_\infty\le2^{j+1}M\},\qquad J_n(M)=\max\{j:\mathcal S_{n,j}(M)\ne\varnothing\}.\] For every nonempty proper \(A\subset\{1,2,3\}\), define \(\mathcal Z_{n,A}=\{r:\{a:r_a=0\}=A\}\), so \(\partial\mathcal R_{n,3}=\bigcup_A\mathcal Z_{n,A}\). Put \(G_n(r)=n^{4/3}\{n^{-1}-\mathcal B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(r)\}\), \(J_{\varepsilon,T}^\star=\sup_u\mathcal J_{\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(u)\), and compute \(\overline G(\mathcal C)\) and \(\underline J^\star\) by outward interval arithmetic of canonical width \(2^{-n}\). Then \[\Delta_{\mathrm{shell}}^\dagger(n,M)=\max\!\left(0,\max_{0\le j\le J_n(M)}\{\overline G(\mathcal S_{n,j}(M))-\underline J^\star\},\max_{\varnothing\ne A\subsetneq\{1,2,3\}}\{\overline G(\mathcal Z_{n,A})-\underline J^\star\}\right).\]
